[LADP.3.2.1] A flat `entity_id` (HA) and a `/`-segmented `topic` (MQTT) are both
ordinary `String` slots; the author writes the regex that fits the key — `[^.]*`
within an entity_id, `[^/]+` for one MQTT segment. An adapter registers no
wildcard recipe, so key-shape knowledge stays in the rule that needs it.
